sentences.text: Cm Appl. 33488/2023 (Directions)
1.  This application has been filed seeking directions for litigation charges for her to defend the case.

She states that she is unable to engage and pay the fee of a counsel.
2. In these circumstances, respondent may approach the Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee ('DHCLSC'), who can appoint her a counsel from Legal Aid.

entities.text: Delhi High Court Legal Services Committee
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. The application is disposed of.
No one appears on behalf of the respondent.
2. It has been noted that no one has been appearing on behalf of the respondent for many dates.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 30/06/2025 at 00:04:43 3.
On 05th March 2024, Mr. R.S. Gautam, Advocate, had appeared and even previously, no one had appeared for the respondent.
4. Court Notice be issued to the respondent in this regard, informing her of the today's order.

5. She shall accordingly take steps to get a counsel from DHCLSC, as directed, and be represented Sunahari Lal vs Archana on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10687475/
1 on the next date of hearing.
6. It has been stated by counsel for the petitioner, that an amount of Rs.6,12,000/- has already been paid in addition to the maintenance.
Settlement was recorded before the Family Court as per the terms of Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) dated 06th June 2019.

7. Counsel for petitioner informs that the quashing petition awaits further process of FIR No.51/2017 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code registered at P.S. New Ashok Nagar, since respondent was not cooperating.

8. List on 29th August 2025.
9.
Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
ANISH DAYAL, J MAY 9, 2025/MK/tk
